transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started. We've got three roles to fill for the filmed stage thriller — Mara Vale, the aerial lead; Tomas Reed, the speaking co-lead; and the Narrator. Our candidates are Alex Chen, Bea Okafor, and Cy Bell, and no one can take more than one role. Before I make any binding decisions, I need to hear from each of you — stunt, talent, and legal — on any production requirements or concerns you need to flag. Who wants to go first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a stunt requirement. I checked the stunt-certification database after yesterday's movement test, and Bea Okafor is the only one of the three candidates with a current aerial-rigging certificate valid for Mara Vale's suspended staircase sequence. This certification result has not yet been added to the casting packet. So from a stunt perspective, only Bea is cleared for the Mara Vale aerial lead role.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a talent-side requirement to flag. I confirmed with the candidates' agents this morning that Alex Chen is the only candidate whose contract permits the required two-day filmed shoot for the Tomas Reed role. Additionally, Alex's availability hold is exactly June 24-25, and that hold is still sitting in my email rather than the production calendar, so it hasn't been formally logged yet. From a talent perspective, only Alex is contractually cleared for Tomas Reed.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have a legal requirement to flag. My contract review found that Cy Bell's signed deal permits voice recording only, requires the on-screen credit 'Narrator — Cy Bell,' and does not authorize a live or filmed physical performance. This restriction has not yet been entered in the casting paperwork. So from a legal perspective, Cy Bell is only cleared for the Narrator role — he cannot be cast as Mara Vale or Tomas Reed.
transcript.speaker: A4
